sents.t: Next Saturday, there is a big book event at Oakville Books.
Mr. Lee says, “Please wear nice clothes.” But I only have T-shirts and old jeans!
So on Sunday, Emma and I take the bus to Riverside Mall.
It is huge.
There are more than one hundred stores, and there is a food court with food from many countries.
In a clothing store, there are shirts in many colors.
I like a light blue shirt.
“What size are you?” the salesperson asks.
“Medium, I think.”
“The fitting room is over there.”
I try on the shirt.
It is a little big.
“Do you have it in a small?”
“Yes, here you go.” The small is perfect.
I also need pants.
There are black pants and gray pants.
I choose the gray pants.
Emma says, “And you need new shoes, Sam!” She is right.
My shoes are very old.
At a shoe store, I find brown shoes.
They are on sale, twenty percent off!
The shirt, pants, and shoes are one hundred and ten dollars.
Now I am ready for the book event.
Then we eat pizza at the food court.
